text:
maya: FYI i opened a PR to refresh the hello quickstart - updates include new Python auth snippet for SDK7, corrected docker run, and removing a stale KMS link. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/501

rachel: thanks. which KMS link was broken?

maya: it pointed at /docs/kms-legacy which no longer exists after the integrations reorg. should instead go to /docs/integrations/kms.

tom: also saw a failing snippet test in CI, it flagged the python env var name.

eileen: yep our tests expect REDWOOD_API_KEY now, not RW_API_KEY. that was probably missed during the quickstart sweep.

maya: here's the snippet that failed:

maya: ```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key=os.getenv("RW_API_KEY"))
```

marco: update to SDK7 please:

marco: ```python
from redwood.api import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.getenv("REDWOOD_API_KEY"))
```

rachel: note for the quickstart: add a one-line migration pointer to /docs/migration/sdk6-to-7. users upgrading will appreciate the callout.

eileen: and add a short token scope mention: "Keys used for quickstart need inference:generate scope" - saves support tickets.

maya: another thing: the docker example was `docker run -p 8081:8080 starter:latest` but the starter listens on 8080; change to `-p 8080:8080`. opened starter issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/starter-app/issues/92

marco: ops confirmed the starter default port is 8080 on main. we'll keep the issue until the template is bumped in the starter repo.

ci-bot: ci/build-docs #501 > snippet-check failed: QuickstartTest.test_python_auth_line. Log: https://ci.internal/builds/501/log

maya: pushed fix to the PR - swapped env var and import, updated docker example, and swapped the KMS link to /docs/integrations/kms. also added the migration blurb and token scope line. bumping CI.

ci-bot: ci/build-docs #501 > rerun: now passing ✅ (https://ci.internal/builds/501/log)

tom: quick nit from product: can we add a tiny sentence in "first deploy" about hosted free credits (link to pricing) and a caution about Dedicated rollbacks?

rachel: good call, add a parenthetical about rollback behavior in Dedicated and link to the rollout docs.

maya: added both notes. i've also opened a small follow-up PR for a minimal Node example since i didn't want to bloat this one: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/502

marco: i'll open the redirect PR for the old KMS path. better to land a redirect while we update the content.

marco: redirect PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/503 - will deploy to staging after CI.

maya: sounds good. merging once redirect is live and staging looks green. thanks all :rocket:
